metaDescription: Nano Banana 2 is the newest version of Google's viral image model. What changed, what still trips it up, and the prompts worth trying first.
bodyHtml:
Nano Banana 2 is the newest generation of Google's Nano Banana image model in Gemini, the follow-up to the model that made figurine portraits and saree edits a whole genre. The short version: prompts you already use keep working, faces hold together with less coaxing, and complicated scenes fall apart less often.

What actually changed

The headline improvement is instruction following. Earlier versions would grab the loudest words in your prompt and ignore the rest; the new model works through multi-part requests more faithfully. Ask for 'a rainy street, me under a red umbrella, neon reflections, keep my face' and you are much more likely to get all four.

Face preservation also needs less babysitting. You should still write a keep line, but one is usually enough, where the old model sometimes needed the request repeated or the style words softened.

Prompts to try on Nano Banana 2

IdeaPaste this
Layered scene'Edit my photo: place me on a rainy evening street under a red umbrella, neon shop reflections on the wet road, cinematic tone. Keep my face exactly the same.'
Two-person edit'From this photo of us, create a formal portrait: matching outfits, studio background, soft light. Keep both faces exactly as they are.'
Style jump'Turn my photo into a hand-painted movie poster, dramatic sky behind me, my name style left blank. Keep my face recognizable.'

What still goes wrong

  • Small text. Better than before, still not reliable. For posters with names or dates, Nano Banana Pro remains the safer pick.
  • Hands and jewellery. Rings, bangles, and interlocked fingers still deserve a second look before you post.
  • Over-stuffed prompts. Instruction following improved; mind reading did not. One scene, one style, one keep line per prompt.

Everything on our main nano banana prompt page runs on the new model without changes, so raid that list first and come back for the newer patterns as trends emerge.

faqs.a: It is the newest generation of Google's Nano Banana image model inside Gemini. Compared with earlier versions it follows multi-part instructions more faithfully and keeps faces consistent with less prompt effort. Existing nano banana prompts work on it unchanged.

faqs.q: Do my old nano banana prompts still work?
faqs.a: Yes. The prompt style is identical, and old prompts generally come out better because the model follows instructions more closely. Keep writing a keep line for your face; it is still needed, just less fragile.

faqs.q: Is Nano Banana 2 free to use?
faqs.a: Gemini's free tier includes the current image model with daily limits, which covers casual editing. Heavy use or the Pro variant may need a paid plan. All prompts on this page are free to copy.
